title: [Suite autour de Teichmüller dont] Teichmülleries, 1981-1982 : notes manuscrites (1981-1983, s.d.), lettres (1981, s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
Setting (from this and the neighbouring pages). X is a closed annulus with coordinates (z,s), where z is in U (the unit circle) and s is in I = [-1,1]. Its universal cover is X̃ = R × I with coordinates (t,s), and z = exp(2iπt). The boundary ∂X has two components, (∂X)_{-1} and (∂X)_{+1}.

What the previous page established. D_{R×R} = {1,σ}⋉(R×R) acts on X̃ and on X. Its elements are written f_{a,b}, with u_{±1} = ±a + b. Two such elements act identically on X iff a = a' and b ≡ b' (mod Z).

What this page does.
(21) The faithful quotient acting on X is D_{R×U} = {1,σ}⋉(R×U). Here σ acts on R×U by (u,θ) ↦ (-u, θ^{-1}).
(22) The action on X is σ(z,s) = (z^{-1},s) and f_{a,θ}(z,s) = (z·exp(2iπas)·θ, s). So f_{a,θ} is a 'linear twist': it rotates each level circle by an angle depending affinely on s. It restricts to the rotation θ·e^{∓2iπa} on the boundary circle s = ∓1.
(23) This lifts to X̃ as σ(t,s) = (-t,s) and f_{a,b}(t,s) = (t+as+b, s), with θ = e^{2iπb}.
(24)–(27) An extra involution ε: s ↦ εs is adjoined; it exchanges the two boundary components. The resulting groups are {±1}⋉D_{R×U} acting on X and {±1}⋉D_{R×R} acting on X̃. ε acts by conjugation by changing the sign of a. The general formula is (ε,σ^ν f_{a,θ})(z,s) = ((z e^{2iπas}θ)^{(-1)^ν}, εs), and its lift is ((-1)^ν(t+as+b), εs).

Purpose (next page). Grothendieck restricts to the elements that induce finite-order rotations on both boundary circles, i.e. a ∈ Q and θ ∈ μ_∞. This gives G = (μ×μ)⋉(Q×Q/Z) and its lift G̃ = (μ×μ)⋉(Q×Q), with 1 → Z → G̃ → G → 1. In effect this is a group of rational (fractional) twists of the annulus. It is a local 'cylinder' model for the Teichmüller-tower/Lego study in the Teichmülleries: the gluing data along a cut circle, including symmetries that reverse orientation and swap ends.
errors: No mathematical error on this page. The relations σ f_{a,b} σ = f_{-a,-b} and ε f_{a,b} ε = f_{-a,b} check out, consistent with the stated semidirect structures.

Minor issue on the next page: it says μ×μ acts 'par symétrie sur les deux facteurs'. In fact ε changes the sign of a only, while σ inverts both a and θ. So only σ = (-1,-1), as identified there, acts on both factors; the phrasing is loose.

ideas.what: Faithful group of affine 'twist' automorphisms of the annulus: D_{R×U} = {1,σ}⋉(R×U), with lift D_{R×R} to the universal cover
ideas.modern_name: Linear twist maps / continuous family of Dehn-type twists of an annulus; isometry-like group of the flat cylinder

ideas.what: Extension by the involution ε swapping the boundary components and by orientation reversal σ, with semidirect products {±1}⋉D
ideas.modern_name: Extended (orientation-reversing, end-swapping) symmetry group of the annulus

ideas.what: Preparation (completed on the next page) for the subgroup of rational twists acting with finite order on the boundary: (μ×μ)⋉(Q×Q/Z), and its Z-central lift to Q×Q
ideas.modern_name: Fractional Dehn twists / rotation numbers at boundary components; compare fractional Dehn twist coefficients
ideas.usually_credited_to: Gabai–Oertel; Honda–Kazez–Matić (fractional Dehn twist coefficient); Nielsen for periodic maps
ideas.where_published: Esquisse d'un programme discusses the Teichmüller tower and cut-and-paste along circles, but not this explicit group

missed.claim: Grothendieck builds the explicit group of rational twists of the annulus, with boundary rotations of finite order. It is an extension of a Q/Z-type group by Z, including the end-swapping and orientation symmetries. This is the local gluing group for cutting surfaces along circles in the Teichmüller tower. In spirit it anticipates the fractional twist / tangential-basepoint bookkeeping used later in Grothendieck–Teichmüller theory. It is not a new result.
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: This is minor: it shows how Grothendieck intended to handle boundary circles with roots-of-unity markings in a discrete/Lego model, a form compatible with Galois actions.

deep.surprise_reason: These are routine, correct, explicit computations of the symmetry/twist group of an annulus and its universal cover. They set up a rational-twist group whose interest lies only in its role within the broader Teichmüller-tower programme.
transcription_corrections: 'A cette action se relève' should read 'Cette action se relève'.
Line after (21): read roughly '≐ où σ opère comme(?) sur R×U par symétrie σ(u,θ)=(-u,θ^{-1})'.
Equation (25) is written '(25)' in the manuscript; the label is partly overwritten.
(27): the lift is ((-1)^ν(t+(as+b)), εs); the second index of f is b ∈ R, and a 'θ' crossed out under it was corrected to b.
